name: LivingAgent 通道桥接 / Channel Bridge
description: 在 OpenClaw Agent 分发前，把选定通道消息转发给 LivingAgent。 / Forward selected channel messages to LivingAgent before OpenClaw Agent dispatch.

endpoint.description: LivingAgent OpenClaw 桥接端点。 / LivingAgent OpenClaw bridge endpoint.

token.description: 共享的 LivingAgent 桥接令牌。受管理部署优先使用 tokenEnv。 / Shared LivingAgent bridge token; managed deployments should prefer tokenEnv.

tokenEnv.description: 保存共享桥接令牌的环境变量。 / Environment variable containing the shared bridge token.

channelId.description: 需要接管的 OpenClaw 通道 ID。 / OpenClaw channel ID to intercept.

allowedAccountIds.description: 可选的精确 OpenClaw 账户白名单。 / Optional exact allowlist of OpenClaw account IDs.

followupDelayMs.description: LivingAgent 后续语言单元之间的延迟。 / Delay between LivingAgent follow-up speech units.

allowRemoteEndpoint.description: 允许使用非回环 HTTPS LivingAgent 端点。 / Allow a non-loopback HTTPS LivingAgent endpoint.
